For example, weighing a stone sample, measuring the water temperature, determining the pH of a soil sample. The data type of the result is a Quantitative Value, that is, a value and a unit. Uitwisseling van buitenlandse adressen moet gebeuren met behulp van het object adresvoorstelling.

The definition relates to Belgian addresses. In other countries, an address may refer to other geographical objects (not building units or plots) or consist of other designations (different from house number and bus number) or of components other than street name, municipality name, or postal code. Alternative address indications than house number or bus number (for example, entrance indication, stair indication, floor indication...) or a building name or room name and similar are possible through association with address expansion. Exchange of foreign addresses must be done using the object address representation.
